question: What does the host persist for a tool call with no id and no name, and can the session be resumed after it? (upstream discussion #13211)

probe.endpoint: .tmp/fake-openai.mjs on 127.0.0.1:8787 — answers a request with no tool result using the two SSE frames from #13211 (tool entry with only an index, then a tool_calls finish), and any later request with one text block

profiles.before: emptycall-before — same provider and model, dsh-remedy not mounted
profiles.after: emptycall — same provider and model, dsh-remedy mounted with journalPath

commands: DSH_HOME=.tmp/empty-call-home PROBE_API_KEY=probe dsh --profile emptycall-before "Reply with exactly: OK"
DSH_HOME=.tmp/empty-call-home PROBE_API_KEY=probe dsh --profile emptycall "Reply with exactly: OK"
probe.note: the endpoint is local and synthetic: it reproduces the adapter output, not a relay incident

before.verdict: the turn dies at admission; the assistant message and tool/call remain with an empty callId

after.verdict: the call is written under a traceable id, the result matches it, and a second turn resumes the same session

rejections.detail: a synthetic call cannot be traced without an id
a synthetic call cannot be traced without an id

findings: Without the plugin the harness reproduces the upstream failure exactly: assistant message with a tool call whose id and name are empty, tool/call with callId "", and "format v4 tool/result at seq 18 requires toolCallId matching its tool source" at exit 1.

With the plugin the same harness completes: the assistant message carries call_remedy_1 / remedy_unattributed, tool/call cites the same id, the result is an UNKNOWN_TOOL error whose toolCallId matches, and the turn ends completed at exit 0.
The session is then resumed by id and completes a second turn, which is the failure #13211 reports as permanent.

The journal records the refusal (code missing-id) twice: once for the session-title request and once for the main step. Only the main step persists a call; the title request never writes an assistant message.
Nothing is repaired and nothing is retried: a real call did not run, so the counter stays refused and the verdict for that stream is quiet (no fusion was seen).
not_proven: The upstream relay was not exercised: the endpoint is local and the stream is synthetic, exactly as the report says its own reproduction was.
Only one provider/model shape (openai-completions, one model) and one prompt were run.
The title-request path is observed but not asserted: its refusal is counted, and its response is never persisted.

verdict.honest_limits: synthetic endpoint; one provider; the adapter itself is still unfixed
